Privacy Policy

Last updated: 1 March 2026

What we collect

We collect your email address, your device identifiers, your location and the articles and videos you view. We combine this information with data we receive from other companies.

How we use it

We use this information to run our news services, to personalize content and to show you advertising.

Sharing and sale

We may sell your personal information to advertising partners and data brokers. We also share your information with our affiliates and with service providers that help us run the services.

Cookies and tracking

We and our advertising partners use cookies, pixels and similar tracking technologies to track your activity across websites and apps.

Retention

We keep your information for as long as we need it for our business purposes.

Your choices

You can ask to see or delete your information by writing to privacy@dailyexample-news.test.
